summary: The new weighted regrouping lemma is stated only for an injectively-indexed candidate family, a strict special case of the natural `Finset` form that its own proof already establishes, and `sum_occCount_eq_card` is then proved separately instead of derived from it. Three `occCount` lemmas with no `Fin` content were also left behind at `Fin N` in the word file.
